title: docs(skills,adr): teach the code-defined datasource credential route (OS_DATASOURCE_NAME_PASSWORD behind the host switch)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3FUiFyiLjMuyYfjHpVM9Ht)_

Fixes #28209

Clause-②: no — governed prose (two ADR amendment notes) and one published skills rules file. No schema, export, type, key, value, error code or runtime behaviour moves; nothing is newly accepted or refused.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：三处文字补上 PR #28208 已落地的「代码声明的数据源在连接时读 `OS_DATASOURCE_NAME_PASSWORD`」这条路：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md` 的凭据一节（变量名规则、主机开关 `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` 及其默认、已声明的 `credentialsRef`/`connector` 仍优先且不回落、给运维的信任提醒）；ADR-0015 的 Amended-by 行、D7 注里「对数据库仍然成立」那句的行内更正、§10 凭据条目和一则带日期的 §10 修订注；ADR-0062 D3 下一则带日期的修订注（该槽在连接解析顺序里的位置、失败文字按 PR #28325 的样子）。另加一条 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28209（分诊 6528463851 / 6538723756）：#28208 落地后这三处文字说少了一条路，写数据源的 agent 会按旧文字去写一个代码数据源铸不出来的 `sys_secret:` 句柄。
- **风险与回滚**：无运行时改动。skills 文件在 token 棘轮内（909 → 910，上限 911），新增文字靠删同文件里的重复句付账，没有折行凑行；删掉的每一句在包内别处仍有落点（正文列出）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md`（凭据一节与被删的五处）；`docs/adr/0015-external-datasource-federation.md`（§10 下的修订注，含信任提醒）；`docs/adr/0062-external-datasource-runtime.md`（D3 修订注）。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → `skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md is 910 tokens (ceiling 911; headroom 1)`；`pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` 绿（skills 文字无 `#NNNN`）。
- **需要你做的**：Tier H（`skills/**` + `docs/adr/**`）：PR 保持 draft，等你本人批准后由席位落地；另请裁定「skills 改动带 patch changeset 而非 `skip-changeset`」这一处与派发令的出入（见 Acceptance notes）。

## What changes

### Measured on `origin/main` `5da3a8ce` before any edit

What PR #28208 shipped, with PR #28325's two corrections, cited by file and line on that tree:

| Fact | Where |
| :--- | :--- |
| Variable name rule: `OS_DATASOURCE_` + the datasource name upper-cased with every character outside `[A-Z0-9]` replaced by `_` + `_PASSWORD` | `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-env-credential.ts:55-57` (`datasourceEnvCredentialVar`) |
| Which names never map: `default` (an `asDefault` connect never reads the slot) | `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-connection-service.ts:772` |
| Which names never map: a name outside the host's code-datasource set (a Setup- or API-created datasource), or a connect whose trigger is not `declared-auto` | `datasource-connection-service.ts:936-941` (`envCredentialVarFor`) |
| No two schema-valid names derive one variable: the name regex is lower-case `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$`, on which upper-casing is injective | `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts:652` |
| The host switch name, `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` | `datasource-env-credential.ts:44` |
| Its reading: unset or empty is off; `on` / `off` in any letter case; any other value throws | `datasource-env-credential.ts:65-78` (`resolveDatasourceEnvCredentialsSwitch`) |
| The throw refuses the boot: the admin plugin reads the switch inside `init()` and wires the slot only when it is on | `packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-plugin.ts:338` (`init`), `:421-429` (the `envCredentials` spread) |
| `os serve` stamps `on` when the operator left it unset or empty, just before it builds the admin plugin | `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:5287-5289`; `packages/cli/src/utils/datasource-env-credentials-default.ts:20-28` |
| `os start` and `os dev` run `serve`, so they get the stamp | `packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts:528`, `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:848` |
| Library compositions: nothing else calls the stamp, and the service's `envCredentials` is optional and absent by default | `datasource-connection-service.ts:171`; `datasource-env-credential.ts:80-89` |
| Resolution order inside `connect()`: `credentialsRef` (fail-closed) → the D7 connector borrow (fail-closed) → the env slot, only when neither is declared and not `asDefault` → the driver factory | `datasource-connection-service.ts:713-738`, `:749-757`, `:770-795`, `:805` (`factory.create`) |
| The value becomes the build's `secret`; an empty or unset variable leaves `envCredentialVar` set so the failure can name it | `datasource-connection-service.ts:791-793` |
| Collision refusal: a second live name deriving the same variable is refused `failed-credentials`, naming both datasources and the variable, before any read | `datasource-connection-service.ts:775-786` |
| A failed connect releases its claim on the variable (PR #28325) | `datasource-connection-service.ts:911` |
| Failure text as PR #28325 left it: the driver's error, then ` (note: datasource 'NAME' is defined in code and reads its credential from OS_DATASOURCE_NAME_PASSWORD at connect, which is not set on this host)`; verdict `failed-degraded` | `datasource-connection-service.ts:921-924` |
| The code-datasource set's three producers: the boot artifact, `default`, and a package installed into the running kernel (the trust consequence) | `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:626`, `packages/runtime/src/default-datasource-plugin.ts:150`, `packages/runtime/src/declared-datasources.ts:188` |
| The spec's shared sentence naming the route, appended to five credential refusals, the refused-key description and the two `password` guidance entries | `packages/spec/src/data/driver/common.zod.ts:103-108` (`CODE_DEFINED_CREDENTIAL_ROUTE`); 7 uses there, 2 in `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts` |

### The three texts

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md`** (reader: the customer's agent writing a `defineDatasource` or a package's `*.datasource.ts`; mistake prevented: inlining a password, or writing a `credentialsRef` handle nothing mints for a code datasource, or expecting a library-built kernel to read the variable).

- The section is now "Credentials — fail-closed". Its opening paragraph says: a code-declared datasource reads its password at connect from `OS_DATASOURCE_NAME_PASSWORD` (NAME = the name upper-cased; exact for every schema-valid name, since the only non-alphanumeric character a valid name can hold is `_`); only while the host switch `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` is `on`; `os serve` / `os start` / `os dev` default it on, a library composition is off, and the switch takes `on` / `off` only; the operator's caution that an installed package may declare a datasource of any free name and so read that variable; and `external` may instead name one channel, which wins and never falls back to the variable. The `credentialsRef` and `connector` bullets and the fail-closed paragraph are kept.
- Paid under the ratchet by deleting restatements in the same file, each with a home elsewhere in the bundle:
  - the "Full field reference" pointer to `datasource.zod.ts` — `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md:12` carries the same path;
  - the `// writable: true` comment in the example — the Writes section two screens down states the gate;
  - the "✅ / ❌ Column mapping" heading and its ✅ bullet — the example's `// columnMap: { cust_region: 'region' }, // remoteColumn → localField` line shows the same key with its direction; the ❌ `field.columnName` rule stays;
  - "(default: `'default'`)" on the object field — `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:87`'s field table carries that default;
  - "and its federated objects registered," in the auto-connect sentence, "(at `defineStack`, else at connect)" on the connector refusal, and "Otherwise every write to the object is rejected." after "read-only by default … both gates must be on" — consequence and timing clauses whose rule survives in the sentence they hung on.
- No re-wrap bought a line: every line that moved either lost a clause or is new text.
- Two readings, lines and tokens (the ratchet's unit): the file 84 → 83 lines, 909 → 910 tokens against a ceiling of 911 (headroom 2 → 1); the whole shipped bundle 219807 → 219808 tokens; the sum of every `SKILL.md` 56506 → 56506 (none edited). No ceiling moves.
- Not taught, on purpose: the collision refusal (no author can write two valid names that collide), the unset-variable failure text (the reason names the variable at runtime), and the per-request plugin-driver limit (no reader among the agents this file serves). All three are recorded in the ADR-0015 note.

**`docs/adr/0015-external-datasource-federation.md`**

- The `Amended by` header line gains the #28208 entry with the ruling record.
- The D7 note's "§10 says credentials reach a datasource only through `credentialsRef`. That stays true for a database." gains an inline, dated correction in the ADR's own `*(amended …)*` form, pointing at the §10 note.
- The §10 Credentials bullet gains a second inline `*(Amended …)*`, in the form the D7 amendment already used there.
- A dated amendment note under §10, in the blockquote form every other note in this ADR uses: the route, the name derivation, where the value goes, then the guards as ruled (the host switch and its default per host; code origin by provenance, never `origin`; a declared channel wins and stays fail-closed; an unset variable leaves the connect as it was and the failure text as PR #28325 left it; the collision refusal and the released claim; the per-request plugin-driver limit), then the trust consequence stated for operators, the spec sentence, and what was not taken.

**`docs/adr/0062-external-datasource-runtime.md`**

- A dated amendment blockquote under D3, the runtime decision: the slot is a second resolution source at the same point, after `credentialsRef` and the D7 borrow and before the factory, with the five conditions under which it is taken, the switch and its wiring at `init()`, the failure text, the collision claim, and a pointer to ADR-0015 §10 for the operator's caution. The normative bullets are not edited, as the ADR's other amendments did not edit theirs.

### The changeset

`.changeset/28209-skills-code-datasource-env-credential.md`: `@objectstack/skills` `patch`, carrying both declaration lines. `skills/**` is copied into that package's `dist/skills` by its build and ships in its `files[]`, so this diff publishes; see Acceptance notes for the conflict with the order.

## Tests

No code changes; the gates below are the tests. The published surface was built: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` under the verify lock → `sync-catalog self-test: 9 cases pass`, `95 file(s) across 11 skill(s) copied from skills/** into dist/skills and read back byte-identical`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The order ruled `skip-changeset`; the repo's rule says otherwise, and this PR follows the repo.** AGENTS.md's Post-Task Checklist: `skip-changeset` "is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package". `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` (its failure text and its GREEN 3 battery) states that a `skills/**` change ships in `@objectstack/skills` and "owes a changeset naming that package, never the `skip-changeset` label", and the precedent changesets for skills-only PRs (for example `.changeset/26475-skills-teach-queues-assignment-rules.md`) are `@objectstack/skills: patch`. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` says that where an order and that file conflict, the file wins and the conflict is named, so: a patch changeset, no `skip-changeset`, and zero label writes at `pr_create` (the order named no other label). The seat relabels if the maintainer rules otherwise.
- **Security.** No credential value, connection string or example password anywhere in the diff or this body; variable names only. The trust note is stated as an operator's caution in each text, with no recipe.
- **Out of scope, reported, not edited:** `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`, case id 3, still answers "A `defineDatasource` entry (`credentialsRef`, never inline credentials)" for a code datasource exposing a Postgres table — the same stale teaching this card corrects, in a fixture the card and the claim's file surface do not name. Its assertions do not require `credentialsRef`, so it stays green. Reported in the os-dev-report for the seat to file or fold in.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` §4 (PR #28208) already teaches the full route; the skills text is deliberately the short form and names no `#NNNN`.
- `pnpm lint` scoped to touched packages: the diff touches no package source; `@objectstack/skills` has no `lint` script and eslint reads no `.md`, so there is nothing to scope it to. Recorded, not run.
